sloka: समरे युद्ध्यमानानामस्माकं प्रेक्षतां पुरः।जघान रुदतीं सीतामिन्द्रिजिद्रावणात्मजः ।। ६.८३.८ ।।
transliteration: samare yuddhyamānānāmasmākaṁ prekṣatāṁ puraḥ।jaghāna rudatīṁ sītāmindrijidrāvaṇātmajaḥ ।। 6.83.8 ।।

translations.english: "Ravana's son, Indrajith struck Sita, who was crying in front of us looking at us while we were fighting in war."
